name: feature-gated
description: Implement a feature behind explicit gates. The gate decides where control goes; the engine forbids a third identical retry, so a stuck approach is replaced rather than repeated.

nodes.name: plan
nodes.task: Break the objective into ordered, testable tasks with dependencies.

nodes.name: implement
nodes.task: Implement the planned change. Match existing style and add tests.

nodes.name: test
nodes.task: Run the project's build and tests. Report exit codes and failures verbatim.

nodes.name: quality-gate
nodes.criteria: The build passes, tests pass with evidence (exit codes quoted), the change matches project conventions, and nothing security-sensitive was touched without review. PASS requires citable evidence, not an assurance.

nodes.name: fix
nodes.task: Diagnose the root cause of the reported failure and fix the cause, not the symptom.

nodes.name: replan
nodes.task: The current approach failed repeatedly. Choose a materially different approach and say why it avoids the previous failure.

nodes.name: deep-review
nodes.task: This needs stronger judgement than the gate could apply. Review thoroughly and report severity-ranked findings.

nodes.name: document
nodes.task: Document what changed and how it was verified. Match existing documentation conventions.
